. Russia also faces unfavorable demographic trends, limiting the recruitment pool and reducing prospects for future economic growth.61 Russia thus faces a disadvantageous global balance of power that will become even more unfavorable as time goes by.
Russia is outmatched by the United States and will be outmatched, if it is not already, by China.

Total NATO defense expenditures exceed those of Russia by a factor of 10. Even if we exclude U.S. defense expenditures, European NATO members still spend more than twice as much on their militaries than Russia. Of course, European allies vary in their operational readiness and willingness to fight Russia.
